old: Monthly housing allowance while enrolled, at the E-5 w/dependents rate for your school's ZIP. Tax-free. Varies widely by location.
new: Housing payments depend on your benefit, duty status, training or enrollment, and location. Post-9/11 GI Bill housing payments are not available while you are on active duty or while using benefits transferred from a spouse on active duty. Confirm your payment with VA and your school or training program.
